definitions: An open-source mobile application framework created by Facebook, used for developing applications for Android, iOS, Web, and UWP by enabling developers to use React along with native platform capabilities.
A JavaScript framework for writing real, natively rendering mobile applications for iOS and Android.
examples: Many startups choose React Native for cross-platform development.
Learning React Native can open doors to mobile app development.
The performance of React Native apps is often comparable to native apps.
